items.prompt:
The Big Bang theory says the universe began about
A) 13.8 billion years ago
B) 100 years ago
C) last week
D) 500 years ago

steps: The universe is about 13.8 billion years old.

items.prompt:
Redshift of distant galaxies shows the universe is
A) expanding
B) shrinking
C) frozen
D) empty

steps: Redshift shows galaxies moving away, so expansion.

items.prompt:
The universe is mostly
A) hydrogen and helium
B) iron and gold
C) oxygen and salt
D) carbon only

steps: Hydrogen and helium dominate the universe.

items.prompt:
Redshift means light from a source is shifted toward red because the source is
A) moving away from us
B) moving toward us
C) standing still
D) getting brighter

The faint radiation across the sky left from the early universe is the
A) cosmic background radiation
B) sunlight
C) moonlight
D) city lights

The Big Bang began from a state that was
A) hot and dense
B) cold and empty
C) frozen solid
D) made of iron

steps: The universe began hot and dense.

items.prompt:
Why is the Big Bang a strong theory?
A) Multiple independent lines of evidence all agree with it
B) It is just a guess
C) Only one person believes it
D) There is no evidence
items.answer: A) Multiple independent lines of evidence all agree with it

steps: Agreeing independent evidence is strong support.

items.prompt:
Matching amounts of hydrogen and helium support the Big Bang because
A) the Big Bang predicts those amounts and observations match
B) they are colorful
C) they are rare
D) they are heavy
items.answer: A) the Big Bang predicts those amounts and observations match
